r1_fixes.accessor_descriptors: plainDataProps requires every own property (incl. non-enumerable) to be an enumerable data property — getters/setters reject via getOwnPropertyDescriptor before any invocation; symbol keys and non-enumerable props also reject. Applies to items, frozen_inputs, and all nested JSON values.
r1_fixes.probes: getter on source_generation_id, getter on item.frozen_inputs, nested getter, setter, symbol key, non-enumerable binding — all reject; getters_never_invoked counter proves zero invocation.

r2_fix: isJsonValue array branch no longer uses v.every (invokes index getters); every own property of an array is validated via getOwnPropertyDescriptor — index accessors, named props, non-enumerable elements, and symbol keys reject uninvoked.
